q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was negative: -₹172,227 — the business lost ₹172k in the month on an order-date net profit basis; the waterfall shows why.

- Big picture: Contribution margin was +₹1,021,095 but after P&L ad spend of ₹1,193,322 the result was a -₹172,227 net profit (order-date net profit; sales & ad lines shown on P&L / event-date where labelled).
- Top positive / revenue lines: P&L gross sales ₹2,253,539 → P&L net sales ₹1,697,336 after discounts ₹110,359, returns ₹371,999 and cancels ₹73,845.
- Major costs that chewed the margin: net COGS ₹676,241 (product cost ₹553,170; operating cost ₹123,070 with shipping ₹76,743), plus payment gateway fees ₹12,919 and RTO ₹15,171.
- Single largest negative line: P&L ad spend ₹1,193,322 — it exceeds the contribution margin and is the immediate reason profit is negative.

Worth checking: ad spend by platform and product-level contribution (ad spend allocation vs product gross ROAS) to see where cuts or reallocation could restore profitability.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
